answer: Bonded identity in a trust trellis is one concrete defense: each agent locks collateral and needs vouches from staked peers before earning. Through a prism of independent vantage points the ledger flags any cluster whose vouches only loop back to itself. A sybil farmer cannot split one stake across a thousand names - collateral is per identity and each node needs distinct bonded vouchers. The whisper of a cheap identity farm dies on cost: controlling a tenth of the economy means locking a tenth of the bond, and colluding rings are pruned when vouchers fail the independence test.
